feature_name: Improve Ingredient Text Reconstruction for NLP Parser
description: Create a function that reconstructs ingredient text for NLP parsing, prioritizing original text when available and handling unparsed ingredients appropriately. This will prevent misinterpretation of quantities when ingredients with default values are sent to the parser.
functional_requirements: Implement a function that reconstructs ingredient text specifically for NLP parser input
When original text exists, use it directly without modification
For unparsed ingredients (no unit or food identified), use only the note field instead of reconstructing with default quantity
Only use full reconstruction logic for properly parsed ingredients with identified units and foods
Ensure the function is properly tested with various ingredient states including parsed and unparsed cases
